name: Big Brother
description: Hold block to charge. When it fills, a giant, slow copy of you stomps in on your side.

displayLines.label: Full charge: a huge copy of you fights for you this round

details:
Hold block to charge (about 9 seconds at base stats; you can't move or shoot while charging). When it is full, Big Brother steps out next to you: a giant copy of you (2.4x size, 3.5x your health, 1.5x damage, bigger bullets, your gun and cards) that moves at under half your speed. He fights on your side until he dies or the round ends, and his kills win rounds for you. Once per round.

Let go and the charge drains back, but not at once. Charging speed comes from Block cooldown and Block duration. No block bubble.
